title: Neon Snake Classic
description: The timeless arcade snake game. Eat apples, grow your length, and avoid crashing into walls or your own tail.
instructions: Use Arrow Keys or WASD to navigate. Space to Pause. Avoid hitting borders and self.

title: Falling Polyominoes
description: The quintessential arcade tile-matching game. Guide falling tetromino blocks to complete solid horizontal lines and rack up combos.
instructions: Left/Right arrow keys to move. Up arrow to rotate. Down arrow to soft drop. Space for hard drop. C to hold piece.

title: 2048 Number Fusion
description: Slide matching numbered tiles across the 4x4 grid. Join tiles with identical numbers to reach the legendary 2048 tile!
instructions: Use Arrow Keys, WASD, or swipe to slide tiles in any direction. When two tiles of the same number touch, they merge into one.

title: T-Rex Desert Runner
description: The world-famous infinite desert sprint. Leap over menacing cacti, duck under soaring pterodactyls, and survive the day-night cycle.
instructions: Space or Up Arrow to jump. Down Arrow to duck. Space to restart on collision.

title: Sky Flap Arcade
description: Navigate through hazardous vertical pipes. Tap with perfect cadence and rhythm to survive as long as possible.
instructions: Press Spacebar, Up Arrow, or Click/Tap anywhere to flap wings and gain altitude.

title: Cosmic Breakout
description: Smash your way through vibrantly colored brick formations. Master angle bounces and clear every stage.
instructions: Mouse or Left/Right keys to control the paddle. Space or Click to launch ball. Destroy all bricks to advance.

title: Cyber Pong Duo
description: The pioneer of digital gaming. Challenge a responsive adaptive AI paddle or play local 2-player split keyboard table tennis.
instructions: Player 1: W/S or Mouse. Player 2: Up/Down Arrows. First to 7 points wins the match.

title: Hextris Hexagonal Puzzle
description: Fast-paced hexagonal puzzle game inspired by Tetris. Match three or more blocks of the same color to clear them.
instructions: Left/Right arrow keys or A/D to rotate the hexagon. Catch incoming blocks and build massive multipliers.

title: Minesweeper Tactics
description: Classic logic and spatial deduction. Clear the minefield without detonating hidden explosives using numerical clues.
instructions: Left-click to reveal a cell. Right-click or hold to plant a flag. Switch between Easy, Medium, and Hard grids.

title: Galactic Defenders
description: Defend the planetary sector from descending waves of alien warships. Eliminate the invasion force before they reach base.
instructions: Left/Right Arrow or A/D to move defender. Spacebar to fire plasma cannons.

title: Pac-Arcade Maze
description: Chomp through labyrinth corridors, collect energy pellets, and outsmart colorful chasing ghosts across retro arcade stages.
instructions: Arrow keys or WASD to navigate corners. Eat large Power Pellets to turn ghosts blue and vulnerable.

title: Sudoku Grid Master
description: Engage your analytical mind with 9x9 Sudoku puzzles featuring instant validation and timer tracking.
instructions: Click any cell to highlight, then click 1-9 or type on your keyboard to place digits.
